summary: Build practical healthcare quality improvement and patient safety skills with PDSA, RCA, dashboards, and accreditation tools. Enrol today.
lede: Healthcare quality improvement and patient safety focuses on identifying care-process risks, measuring performance, and testing changes. Designed for healthcare professionals involved in clinical, operational, or governance work, the course supports practical improvement of everyday services through PDSA cycles. Learners practice interpreting incident and audit information, mapping processes, and tracking safety measures with run charts, control charts, and KPI dashboards.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for healthcare professionals who already work with clinical, operational, or governance processes and need a structured way to improve safety and quality. It is especially relevant if you are responsible for incidents, audits, patient flow, accreditation preparation, or executive reporting.
audience: Medical Records or Health Information Officer
modules: Lean and Six Sigma in Healthcare
prerequisites: You will need a laptop, spreadsheet software, and the ability to work with sample incident, audit, or quality data during exercises. It helps to bring a current clinical quality issue, a patient safety concern, or an existing audit topic from your workplace so you can apply the tools directly.
